reason: A DSH plugin for organizing projects, workspaces, and sessions through searchable project navigation, sidebar views, archive management, and optional multi-folder grouping.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH 提供项目、Workspace 和会话整理功能，支持搜索、侧边栏管理、归档查看及可选的多文件夹项目。
summaries.en: Organizes DSH projects, workspaces, and sessions with searchable navigation, sidebar management, archive views, and optional multi-folder projects.

capabilities: Organizes and switches between projects and workspaces
Searches project names, chat titles, and optionally indexed chat content
Opens native or in-app directory pickers and file manager locations
Stores display preferences and project combinations in browser localStorage
